## Start with the reader's question

Introduce the problem, question or opportunity. Explain why it matters to the reader.

## Explain the idea

Use short sections, descriptive headings, plain language and examples. Define specialist terms. Credit sources and link to original research where possible.

## Put it into practice

Offer a concrete exercise, checklist or small next step.

## What to remember
